title: Section 307 — Theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to the committing of the theft

content.overview: BNS s. 307 — Theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to the committing of the theft.
content.study:
Introduction and meaning
Theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to the committing of the theft. BNS restatement of IPC 382. Elements are substantially the same; cite the BNS number for offences on or after 1 July 2024. BNS restatement of IPC 382. Cite the BNS number for facts on or after 1 July 2024.
In student language: BNS s. 307 is the rule on “Theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to the committing of the theft”. The section provides that whoever commits theft, having made preparation for causing death, or hurt, or restraint, or fear of death, or of hurt, or of restraint, to any person, in order to the committing of such theft, or in order to the effecting of his escape after the committing of such theft, or in order to the retaining of property taken by such theft, shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine. Do not stop at the heading. An examiner awards marks for the ingredients, the explanations and the illustrations, not for writing the title alone.

Why this is asked
Criminal law arguments turn on statutory ingredients. BNS s. 307 exists so that “Theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to the committing of the theft” has a closed legal test in Chapter XVII — Of Offences Against Property. An authoritative analysis defines the concept, lists every ingredient, walks the statutory illustrations, states exceptions, and applies the test methodically to facts.
Chapter setting: Theft, snatching, extortion, robbery, dacoity, trust, cheating, mischief, trespass.

The provision in detail
307. Whoever commits theft, having made preparation for causing death, or hurt, or restraint, or fear of death, or of hurt, or of restraint, to any person, in order to the committing of such theft, or in order to the effecting of his escape after the committing of such theft, or in order to the retaining of property taken by such theft, shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine

Essential ingredients
1. Whoever commits theft, having made preparation for causing death, or hurt, or restraint, or fear of death, or of hurt, or of restraint, to any person, in order to the committing of such theft, or in order to the effecting of his escape after the committing of such theft, or in order to the retaining of property taken by such theft, shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years, and shall also be liable to fine

Statutory illustrations
Illustration (a). A commits theft on property in Z’s possession; and while committing this theft, he has a loaded pistol under his garment, having provided this pistol for the purpose of hurting Z in case Z should resist. A has committed the offence defined in this section

Exam use: quote illustration (a), then write which ingredient of BNS s. 307 it proves. Copying the illustration without that mapping sentence does not score.

Illustration (b). A picks Z’s pocket, having posted several of his companions near him, in order that they may restrain Z, if Z should perceive what is passing and should resist, or should attempt to apprehend A. A has committed the offence defined in this section

Exam use: quote illustration (b), then write which ingredient of BNS s. 307 it proves. Copying the illustration without that mapping sentence does not score.

Illustration (c). Of extortion

Exam use: quote illustration (c), then write which ingredient of BNS s. 307 it proves. Copying the illustration without that mapping sentence does not score.

enhancement.detailedExplanation: Section 307 constitutes a key component of Chapter XVII (Of Offences against Property) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023, addressing theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to the committing of the theft. The provision balances personal liberty with public interest and social order. The prosecution must establish every statutory element beyond reasonable doubt: the specified actus reus, the requisite mens rea, and any relevant statutory circumstances. Modern judicial interpretation emphasizes substantive fairness, proportionality in sentencing, and adherence to constitutional safeguards. Where statutory exceptions or provisos are attached to the section, the accused must establish facts bringing the case within such provisions under evidentiary standards.
examples: Teaching example (Standard application): An individual intentionally commits acts satisfying the statutory formula of theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to the committing of the theft under Section 307 without lawful authority. The individual is liable under BNS s. 307.

Teaching example (Absence of mens rea / Lawful exception): A person acts in good faith or without the requisite statutory mental element under circumstances recognized by law. The essential ingredients of Section 307 are not satisfied; no penal liability attaches.
distinctions: Section 307 vs General Attempt: Section 307 penalizes the substantive conduct specified in Chapter XVII; inchoate attempts without specific provisions fall under the general attempt provisions.
Section 307 vs Cognate Chapter Offences: Liability under Section 307 is distinguished by its specific mental threshold and the particular legal interest protected under Of Offences against Property.
problemApplication: Issue: Whether the accused is liable under BNS s. 307 for conduct relating to theft after preparation made for causing death, hurt or restraint in order to the committing of the theft.
Rule: Under BNS s. 307, liability attaches upon proof of the statutory actus reus accompanied by the requisite mens rea without lawful justification.
Application: The evidence demonstrates that the accused performed the specified act with the required state of mind, satisfying all statutory ingredients of Section 307.
Conclusion: The accused is guilty of an offence under BNS s. 307 and subject to the prescribed punishment.
